FAYE LAU Pretty sure you need depth perception for that gig.
BARDON SCHAEFFER Wouldn't work even if you had a robo-eye. I've seen you in the field. You like getting your hands dirty.
FAYE LAU No I don't. But, I'm not afraid to do what's necessary.
BARDON SCHAEFFER You ready to work directly for the president. For your country?
FAYE LAU Funny.
BARDON SCHAEFFER What's funny?
FAYE LAU You just promoted me to my old job.
BARDON SCHAEFFER The Division was activated by the president, but as soon they went against him and your AI forgot to update with the line of succession, you stopped working for the president. The way I see it, you and the rogues we've recruited are the only agents still on mission. But that doesn't mean I have to like it or you.
